CFP
ICOSIN 2026: International Conference on Smart Informatics
Conference Hall, Universitas Tanjungpura
Pontianak, Indonesia, November 12, 2026
Conference web pagehttps://conf.informatika.untan.ac.id/icosin2026/
Abstract registration deadlineOctober 11, 2026
Submission deadlineOctober 12, 2026
Topics: natural language processing generative ai machine learning computer vision

Update: Due to haze conditions in Pontianak, ICOSIN 2026 has been rescheduled to November 12, 2026 (originally September 12). All dates on this page reflect the revised schedule. (See international coverage: Al Jazeera, Tempo.)

 

ICOSIN 2026 welcomes everyone — researchers, academics, and practitioners alike — to share work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computing, and culture — with special attention to the unique linguistic and cultural landscape of Borneo. The conference features public lectures, keynote talks, and collaborative sessions between UNTAN and UNIMAS.

Submission Guidelines

All papers must be original and not simultaneously submitted to another journal or conference. The following paper categories are welcome.

  • Prepare your full paper (4–6 pages, IEEE two-column format) using the provided paper template.
  • Clearly indicate your preferred track: Oral or Poster (final assignment follows the review ranking above).
  • Include author name(s), institutional affiliation, and contact email.
  • All accepted papers (oral and poster) will be published in the ICOSIN Proceedings with e-ISSN and DOI (Crossref), indexed by Google Scholar.
  • Accepted authors will present at ICOSIN 2026 and receive an official certificate.
  • Selected best papers will be invited for extended submission to a partner journal (to be confirmed).

List of Topics

  • Special Track: AI and Cultural Heritage

  • Local/regional language processing (NLP, speech recognition, machine translation for regional languages)
  • Computer vision for cultural artifacts (textile motifs, carvings, manuscripts)
  • Digital heritage preservation and restoration
  • Cultural recommender systems and digital archives
  • AI ethics and indigenous data sovereignty
  • Human-computer interaction with local cultural context

  • General Track: AI, Data Science & Computing

  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning
  • Natural Language Processing
  • Computer Vision & Image Processing
  • Data Mining & Big Data Analytics
  • Generative AI
  • Software Engineering & System Development
  • Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems
  • Internet of Things (IoT)
  • Cybersecurity
  • Database & Information Systems
  • AI applications in education, agriculture, environment, and healthcare

 

Venue

The conference will be held in Gedung Konferensi UNTAN, Pontianak, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia

Contact

All questions about submissions should be emailed to icosin@informatics.untan.ac.id
